About the job

About UsWe are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH+. One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion & Diversity at PVH here.Position SummaryThe Quality Assurance and Engineering Test Engineer will establish and drive common, Global Quality Assurance practices across product areas to ensure the successful delivery of PVH applications and systems. This role will actively partner across the Global PVH IT teams to deliver products and services to our PVH brands and partners through sound quality assurance practices, guided by a scalable governance process, and standardized testing framework, to reduce risk, ensure user satisfaction, and support continuous improvement of Quality across PVH.He/she will work closely with PVH IT application teams, Program and Project Management, vendors and Business Process partners to strategize & align long term solutions for specialized testing (test automation) including roadmap, tools, framework & approachPrimary Responsibilities/Accountabilities Of The Job      Serve as the global automation engineer in the Quality Assurance & Testing space for the enterprise.Drive creation and delivery of a global specialized testing practice -automation; Driving the use of Tools for creation and maintenance of automation scriptsSupport in capturing testing metrics for Automation testing and oversee reporting of Testing StatusPlan, design, build & deliver automation test strategy, test plans, scripts, and defect management under the guidance of PVH IT QA practice.Support Project and Program Managers on the execution of automation integration, regression, and ad-hoc tests according to approved test plans and testing schedule.Continually augment the quality assurance team’s experiences and skills with appropriate training, technologies, and techniques

personal_details.label: Senior SDET | API & UI Automation | Java · Python · Microservices
personal_details.summary: Senior SDET with 6 years scaling API and UI automation across airline, quick-commerce, and OTT microservice domains. Architected 1000+ test case suites using REST Assured, TestNG, and Cucumber BDD; reduced QA overhead by 12 hrs/week through AI-assisted automation (AiDE). Experienced in shift-left testing, CI/CD integration, and observability-driven quality across distributed systems.

achievements: PNR Linking & SSR [REST Assured · ReadyAPI · BDD · AiDE] : Architected automation frameworks for airline domain; built 1000+ test cases cutting effort from 750 to 50 man-hours (93% reduction).
Order Bags [REST Assured · AiDE · E2E] : Leveraged Agentic AI (AiDE) to accelerate framework implementation by 50% and reduce test drafting time by 75% across service-level and E2E validations.
Automated Kibana log analysis, issue reporting, and data quality validation pipelines; eliminated manual intervention and saved 12 hrs/week of QA overhead.
Drove shift-left testing practices using Azure DevOps and BDD Cucumber, reducing bug leakage to production across 3 airline microservice domains.
Automated end-to-end API flows and DB validations using the Ekam Java Framework for 4 key features, achieving 60% test coverage in a microservices-based Merchant Service suite.
Led observability-driven root cause analysis of daily stability failures using Allure reports, Google Metrics Explorer, and Kibana across GCP-hosted services.
Owned full SDLC feature testing : planning through deployment ensuring minimal production bug leakage via Jenkins CI/CD pipelines.
Designed a BDD automation framework using Python, Appium, and TestRail API; automated ~50% of sanity suite, saving ~5 man-days/month.
Contributed to a ₹100Cr OTT app under Agile SDLC; directly improved iOS App Store rating from 1.9 → 3.5 through systematic API and stability testing.
Performed domain API, stability, and KPI testing for Web and iOS platforms using Charles Proxy, Postman, and Burp Suite.
